# mikrotik_wireless_security_profile (Resource)
Creates a MikroTik Wireless Security Profile.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the security profile.

### Optional

- `authentication_types` (Set of String) List of authentication types. Supported values: wpa-psk, wpa2-psk, wpa-eap, wpa2-eap.
- `mode` (String) Security mode. Supported values: none, static-keys-optional, static-keys-required, dynamic-keys. Default: `none`.
- `wpa2_pre_shared_key` (String, Sensitive) WPA2 pre-shared key. Used when authentication includes wpa2-psk.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this resource.
